title: Police Worry About New Limits on Chinese Drones
summary:
Many police departments in the United States use drones. Drones are small flying machines with cameras. Police use them to search for lost people, look at crashes and watch big crowds. About 6,000 police agencies have drones.

Most of these drones are made by DJI, a company in China. The Trump administration wants Americans to buy drones made in the U.S. It has banned many new foreign drones and added extra taxes on some others. The government says Chinese drones could be a safety risk. DJI says that is not true.

In Ocean County, New Jersey, police used a drone in July to drop floats to two swimmers in trouble. Both were brought safely to shore. The leader of the drone team, Kevin Fennessy, says American drones are good but cost about three times as much.

Some states have banned police from using foreign drones. Fennessy says if police must switch, "the funding's got to be there."
why_it_matters: Drones help police find lost people and rescue swimmers, so these rules can affect how safe communities are.
